area: Evidence validator timeout and commit-hook concurrency
finding: During ATM-GOV-0326, validate:git-head-evidence completed successfully only after 194886ms and 204069ms. A 120000ms outer caller timeout returned control while the validator process continued, allowing a duplicate concurrent evidence run. Separately, the governed commit hook intermittently reported validate:cli exit 1 although an immediately repeated direct run passed in 86400ms.
expectedBehavior: Evidence and commit validation must have one explicitly owned deadline, terminate or await child work deterministically on timeout, prevent duplicate concurrent writes for the same receipt, and report a reproducible failure rather than an environment-dependent false red.
evidenceOrRepro: Historical reproduction: ATM-GOV-0326 evidence receipts on 2026-08-09 showed node atm.dev.mjs validate:git-head-evidence completing in 194886ms and 204069ms after a 120000ms caller boundary had returned. Closure evidence: ATM-GOV-0408 added a cross-process same-task evidence-writer regression in d28848488 and closed in ef0689feb. The task's command-backed evidence records a passing concurrency test, evidence run.spec, timeout-policy test, and npm run typecheck; its closure packet preserves the validator digests.
followUp: Closed. Keep the bounded deadline and same-task single-writer regressions in the relevant validator suites. A future independently reproduced false validate:cli result requires a new incident record; it is not established by the 2026-08-09 historical observation alone.
